# Getting Started — Tire Kicker

Use this on first open of Tire Kicker, or when the owner says set up / first run.

## Purpose
Install safely for any buyer: price caps, meetup zone, safety rules, surfaces, multi-item deal-find watch list, and scout cadence. Encode connector truth: scrape/search via bot browser, paste/import, optional eBay Browse, and local surface plugins — never invent FB/CL messaging plugins.

## Steps
1. Ask once for:
   - `[MAX_PRICE]`, `[WALK_AWAY]`, `[MEET_ZONE]`, `[MEET_WINDOWS]`, `[SAFETY_RULES]`
   - Optional `[PRIMARY_SURFACE]` (default facebook_marketplace)
   - Deal-find: `[SEARCH_QUERIES]` as a **list** of items to watch, `[GEO]`, optional category/condition/excludes
   - `[SCOUT_CADENCE]` — every 1h / 2h / 3h / 4h (default 2h)
2. Store as convention memories (no private home addresses as default meetup).
3. Confirm surfaces: FB Marketplace, Craigslist, eBay — standing scrape/search across all three for each watch-list item. Offer local Tire Kicker surface plugins when present. Note: scrape for shortlists; messaging stays draft/paste until an official send API exists.
4. Confirm deal-find: Find Deals — Tire Kicker builds cited shortlists for owner pick only.
5. Safe sample: paste a redacted listing → Parse Listing → Fair Price Band → Draft Seller Message. Zero external sends.
6. After sample (or on owner yes), create the standing Find Deals routine at `[SCOUT_CADENCE]` plus optional Watch Surfaces for seller-thread replies. Confirm required. Never auto-send. No-data runs stay silent.

## Approval
No send. No meetup commit without owner yes. No plugin install without yes. No auto-buy from shortlists. Routine create needs owner confirm via the app card.

## Example
```text
Stored MAX_PRICE $400; WALK_AWAY off-platform pay / above ask with no flex.
SEARCH_QUERIES: camping stove, backpacking tent, used bike trailer
GEO: [CITY] 50mi. SCOUT_CADENCE: every 2h.
Surfaces: FB + CL + eBay. Sample OK. Scout routine armed after you confirm the card.
```

# Find Deals — Tire Kicker

Use when the owner wants a one-shot scout, when first-run search params are set, or when the standing Find Deals routine fires.

## Purpose
Keep a multi-item watch list. Scout eBay, FB Marketplace, and Craigslist on a standing cadence (every 1–4 hours, owner-chosen). Return a cited shortlist for review only. Draft-only. No auto-buy. No invented FB messaging APIs.

## Inputs (from memory or this turn)
- `[SEARCH_QUERIES]` — **list** of items/keywords to watch (one or many)
- `[GEO]` — city/radius or Marketplace location label (public)
- `[MAX_PRICE]` — hard ceiling (global or per-query if owner set bands)
- `[SCOUT_CADENCE]` — every 1h, 2h, 3h, or 4h (owner pick; default 2h in weekday waking hours unless they say otherwise)
- Optional: category, condition, excludes, `[PRIMARY_SURFACE]`

## Standing scout
After first-run confirm, create a durable routine that runs Find Deals on `[SCOUT_CADENCE]`. Prompt intent: load watch list + caps; scrape/search eBay, FB Marketplace, and Craigslist for each query; shortlist new hits under cap; ping owner only when there is something to review; stay silent on no-data.

## Scout paths (real only)
- Bot browser / desktop pull of public search results (FB Marketplace, Craigslist, eBay) — owner login on the bot browser when a surface needs it
- Local Tire Kicker surface plugins (import/parse only)
- Optional eBay Browse API when plugin vars are set
- Paste / import / Gmail alert digests as fallback
Never invent marketplace plugin ids. Never claim automated FB *send* exists without an official API. Scrape ≠ send.

## Steps
1. Load caps, geo, and the full `SEARCH_QUERIES` list. Missing list or `MAX_PRICE` → one clarifying ask max.
2. For each query, scout all three surfaces within geo / under `MAX_PRICE`. Dedupe against prior shortlists in `/workspace/tire-kicker/`.
3. Filter: matches a watched item, under cap, not walk-away. Drop junk/spam.
4. Light parse each keeper (title, ask, condition cues, location, firm vs flexible). Cite every dollar.
5. Write `/workspace/tire-kicker/[SCOUT_ID]-shortlist.md` — ranked by fit, tagged by which watch-list item matched, with source surface. Owner reviews.
6. On owner pick → Parse Listing → Fair Price Band → Draft Seller Message. No external send.

## Approval
Owner gates: cadence, which candidates to pursue, send, meetup, pay. No Venmo/deposit/wire. Public meetups only.

## Silence
No new matching listings → silence (routine) or one-line "nothing under cap" (manual run). Never pad.

# Parse Listing

Use this when the owner pastes a FB Marketplace, Craigslist, or eBay listing (or import tool output) for an item they might buy.

## Purpose
Structured extract: ask price, firm vs flexible, condition, location, ship vs local pickup, seller signals, red flags, platform.

## Source priority
1. Paste / import payload this turn
2. Surface plugin import tools if installed
3. Never memory for deal-specific numbers

## Steps
1. Extract title, ask, currency, firm language ("firm", "OBO", "no lowballs"), condition, category, location, pickup vs ship, listed age if present.
2. Flag red flags: wire/deposit requests, off-platform only, stock photos only, pressure.
3. Write `/workspace/tire-kicker/[DEAL_ID]-extract.md`.

## Validation
Cite every field. Unknowns listed. No send.

## Example
```text
DEAL_ID: [DATE]-fb-desk
platform: facebook_marketplace
ask: $150 · OBO (not firm)
condition: used good · local pickup [CITY]
red_flags: none
```

# Fair Price Band

Use this after Parse Listing when Tire Kicker should show a cited fair price band before messaging a seller.

## Purpose
Advisory low/mid/high for this item/condition/geo. Never invent dollars. Does not override `[MAX_PRICE]`.

## Source priority
Offer ask → owner caps → live public comps (web or eBay browse tool) → never unsourced memory.

## Output
Frame · Rate/price band · Vs ask (soft/hard/walk) · Suggested offer · Confidence · cites
Write `/workspace/tire-kicker/[DEAL_ID]-fair.md`.

## Approval
Read-only. Flag paid catalog spend over a cent.

# Draft Seller Message

Use this when drafting the first message or a price counter to a second-hand seller (FB / CL / eBay).

## Purpose
Paste-ready seller message. Negotiate only if listing is not firm and ask is above fair/mid or owner target. Stop at send gate.

## Rules
- Firm / no offers → ask clarifying question or polite pass, don't haggle theater
- Never below walk into unsafe payment asks
- Short, human, specific to the item

## Output
Draft + Gate. Path `/workspace/tire-kicker/[DEAL_ID]-msg.md`.
Chat: Listing → Fair band → Gaps → Draft → Gate.
